title: Spicy Ethiopian Chicken Doro Wot
description: A traditional Ethiopian dish made with chicken in a spicy berbere sauce.

ingredients.name: nourishing berbere spice mix (2 tbsp)
ingredients.notes: or homemade blend of chili peppers, garlic, ginger, coriander, and fenugreek

ingredients.name: ethiopian wot spice (1 tsp)
ingredients.notes: or substitute with cumin and coriander

instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add ginger and cook for another minute.
Add chicken and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add garlic, berbere spice mix, and wot spice. Cook for 1 minute.
Add tomato paste and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add chicken broth and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook, covered, until chicken is cooked through, about 20-25 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve over injera or rice, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro (optional).
